module_summary: DarkRISCV 3-stage RV32I core: fetch PC, registered decode (instruction, opcode flags, immediates), single-cycle execute with register file, ALU, branch unit and load/store bus, plus halt/flush control and M/S trap CSRs.

anchors.name: IFPC
anchors.why: Fetch-stage PC driving IADDR; loads reset, trap, jump target or PC+4.

anchors.name: XIDATA
anchors.why: Decode/execute instruction register; fields feed register pointers, FCT3 and CSR decode.

anchors.name: REGS
anchors.why: 32x32 register file written via DPTR, read via S1PTR/S2PTR.

anchors.name: FLUSH
anchors.why: Pipeline flush countdown after reset, jumps, traps; squashes decoded opcodes.

anchors.name: HLT
anchors.why: Stall while instruction or data bus request lacks ack; freezes all stages.

anchors.name: RMDATA
anchors.why: ALU result for register/immediate ops selected by FCT3, written to REGS.

anchors.name: DADDR
anchors.why: Data bus address U1REG+SIMM, also JALR target.

anchors.name: IDATA
anchors.why: Fetched instruction word from instruction bus.

anchors.name: DATAI
anchors.why: Load data from data bus, aligned/extended into LDATA.

anchors.name: DATAO
anchors.why: Store data positioned by byte lane from SDATA.

anchors.name: DDREQ
anchors.why: Data bus request for load or store; stalls core until DDACK.

anchors.name: DDACK
anchors.why: Data bus acknowledge releasing HLT.

anchors.name: PC
anchors.why: Execute-stage PC used for branch target and trap EPC.

anchors.name: JREQ
anchors.why: Jump/taken-branch request redirecting IFPC and triggering flush.

anchors.name: JVAL
anchors.why: Jump target: DADDR for JALR else PC+SIMM.

anchors.name: LCC
anchors.why: Load decode: drives DRD/DDREQ and selects LDATA writeback.

anchors.name: SCC
anchors.why: Store decode: drives DWR/DDREQ and read/write direction.

anchors.name: FCT3
anchors.why: funct3 field selecting ALU op, branch condition and access size.

anchors.name: XSIMM
anchors.why: Registered sign-extended immediate per instruction format.

anchors.name: MIP
anchors.why: Machine interrupt pending; with JREQ redirects PC to MTVEC.

anchors.name: IDREQ
anchors.why: Instruction fetch request, active out of reset.

anchors.name: IDACK
anchors.why: Instruction fetch acknowledge releasing HLT.

anchors.name: IDPC
anchors.why: Decode-stage PC, link value for JAL/JALR.

anchors.name: HLT2
anchors.why: Delayed halt selecting held instruction IDATA2.

anchors.name: IDATA2
anchors.why: Instruction captured on halt transitions, replayed after stall.

anchors.name: IDATAX
anchors.why: Halt-aware instruction feeding decode registers.

anchors.name: XMCC
anchors.why: Registered immediate-ALU decode selecting SIMM as second operand.

anchors.name: CSRX
anchors.why: CSR instruction decode enabling CSR writes and CRDATA writeback.

anchors.name: EBRK
anchors.why: EBREAK decode causing trap to STVEC and flush.

anchors.name: MRET
anchors.why: MRET decode returning PC to MEPC.

anchors.name: SRET
anchors.why: SRET decode returning PC to SEPC.

anchors.name: DPTR
anchors.why: Destination register index for REGS writeback.

anchors.name: S1PTR
anchors.why: Source-1 register index reading U1REG.

anchors.name: S2PTR
anchors.why: Source-2 register index reading U2REG.

anchors.name: U1REG
anchors.why: Source-1 operand feeding ALU, address adder and CSR mask.

anchors.name: BMUX
anchors.why: Branch condition comparator result by FCT3.

anchors.name: PCSIMM
anchors.why: PC+immediate for branch/JAL target and AUIPC.

anchors.name: LDATA
anchors.why: Byte/half aligned, sign-extended load data for writeback.

anchors.name: DWR
anchors.why: Data bus write strobe for stores.

anchors.name: DRD
anchors.why: Data bus read strobe for loads.

anchors.name: DBE
anchors.why: Byte enables from access size and address low bits.

anchors.name: XRES
anchors.why: Registered core reset forcing reset PC, flush and CSR clear.

anchors.name: IERR
anchors.why: Illegal instruction flag causing trap and flush.

anchors.name: DAER
anchors.why: Data address misalignment flag causing trap.

anchors.name: IAER
anchors.why: Instruction address misalignment flag causing trap.

anchors.name: MSTATUS
anchors.why: Machine status; MIE bit gates interrupt pending.

anchors.name: MIE
anchors.why: Machine interrupt enable mask gating MIP.

anchors.name: MTVEC
anchors.why: Interrupt vector loaded into IFPC on pending interrupt.

anchors.name: MEPC
anchors.why: Saved return PC on interrupt, restored by MRET.

anchors.name: MCAUSE
anchors.why: Interrupt cause readable via CSR.

anchors.name: STVEC
anchors.why: Exception vector; nonzero enables trap redirect of IFPC.

anchors.name: SEPC
anchors.why: Saved PC on exception, restored by SRET.

anchors.name: SCAUSE
anchors.why: Exception cause code from error flags.

anchors.name: CRDATA
anchors.why: CSR read mux by CSR address, written back to REGS.

anchors.name: WRDATA
anchors.why: CSR write value for CSRRW/RS/RC.

anchors.name: CSRCLK
anchors.why: 64-bit cycle counter CSR.

anchors.name: CSRINS
anchors.why: 64-bit retired-instruction counter CSR.

anchors.name: DEBUG
anchors.why: Debug view of IRQ, MIP, MIE and MRET.

groups.name: Instruction fetch
groups.description: Fetch PC, instruction bus request and halt-safe instruction capture.

groups.name: Decode
groups.description: Registered instruction, opcode flags and immediates; FLUSH-gated decode.

groups.name: Register file
groups.description: Register array with two read ports and writeback mux.

groups.name: Execute
groups.description: ALU, branch comparator and jump target generation.

groups.name: Load/store unit
groups.description: Data bus address, byte lanes, strobes and load alignment.

groups.name: Pipeline control
groups.description: Halt on bus wait, flush after redirects, exception detection.

groups.name: CSR and traps
groups.description: Machine interrupt and supervisor exception CSRs with read/write mux.
